probes.question: Early jiaozi notes were issued to replace what?
True or false: early jiaozi notes came in standard denominations.

image.alt: Flat illustration of an old banknote with a seal above a string of square-holed coins.

panels.text: Jiaozi was a form of promissory note which appeared around the 11th century in the Sichuan capital of Chengdu, China.
It was first used in present-day Sichuan by a private merchant enterprise. The notes were issued to replace the heavy coins that circulated at the time.
To combat counterfeiting, jiaozi were stamped with multiple banknote seals. Early notes did not have standard denominations.
Numismatists regard jiaozi as the first paper money in history, a development of the Chinese Song Dynasty (960-1279 CE).
